    def _build_observer(self):
        template = (
            "def observe(state):\n"
            "    {svars} = state\n"
            "    I_AMPA = geff_AMPA*(v - E_AMPA)\n"
            "    I_GABA = geff_GABA*(v - E_GABA)\n"
            "    return np.array([{voi_names}])"
        )
        svars = ",".join(self.state_variables)
        if len(self.state_variables) == 1:
            svars += ","
        code = template.format(
            svars=svars, voi_names=",".join(self.variables_of_interest)
        )
        # the namespace dfun runs in, plus this model's parameters
        namespace = {**globals(), **self.__dict__}
        self.log.debug("building observer with code:\n%s", code)
        exec(code, namespace)
        self.observe = namespace["observe"]
        self.observe.code = code

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        v = state_variables[0, :]
        x_AMPA = state_variables[1, :]
        geff_AMPA = state_variables[2, :]
        x_GABA = state_variables[3, :]
        geff_GABA = state_variables[4, :]
        t_ref = state_variables[5, :]

        V_leak = self.V_leak
        tau_m = self.tau_m
        g_leak = self.g_leak
        E_AMPA = self.E_AMPA
        E_GABA = self.E_GABA
        tau_r_AMPA = self.tau_r_AMPA
        tau_d_AMPA = self.tau_d_AMPA
        tau_r_GABA = self.tau_r_GABA
        tau_d_GABA = self.tau_d_GABA
        g_AMPA_rec = self.g_AMPA_rec
        g_AMPA_tha = self.g_AMPA_tha
        g_AMPA_cort = self.g_AMPA_cort
        g_GABA = self.g_GABA

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        S_AMPA_rec = coupling[0, :]
        S_AMPA_tha = coupling[1, :]
        S_AMPA_cort = coupling[2, :]
        S_GABA = coupling[3, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.I_AMPA = I_AMPA = geff_AMPA * (v - E_AMPA)
        self.I_GABA = I_GABA = geff_GABA * (v - E_GABA)
        self.integrating = integrating = np.where(np.greater(t_ref, 0), 0.0, 1.0)

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(
                integrating * (V_leak - v - (I_AMPA + I_GABA) / g_leak) / tau_m
            ),  # v
            np.asarray(
                (
                    -x_AMPA
                    + tau_m
                    * (
                        S_AMPA_cort * g_AMPA_cort
                        + S_AMPA_rec * g_AMPA_rec
                        + S_AMPA_tha * g_AMPA_tha
                    )
                )
                / tau_r_AMPA
            ),  # x_AMPA
            np.asarray((x_AMPA - geff_AMPA) / tau_d_AMPA),  # geff_AMPA
            np.asarray((-x_GABA + S_GABA * g_GABA * tau_m) / tau_r_GABA),  # x_GABA
            np.asarray((x_GABA - geff_GABA) / tau_d_GABA),  # geff_GABA
            np.asarray(-1 + integrating),  # t_ref
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
